visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man dressed in a red Santa Claus suit and a white artificial beard enters from a hallway into a room. He holds two Super Mario-themed board game boxes: Jenga and The Game of Life. He smiles at the camera while standing in a bright indoor residential hallway with light-colored walls. (2) Two young girls are seated at a white table in a living room. The girl in the foreground has dark hair and wears a white shirt, looking surprised with her mouth open. The girl in the background wears a grey hoodie and smiles. (3) The man in the Santa suit leans over the two girls from behind, placing both game boxes on the table. The lighting is warm and domestic. Yellow variety-style captions appear at the bottom center of the frame. (4) The younger girl holds up 'The Game of Life' box directly to the camera, showcasing the Super Mario characters on the cover. She has a bright expression and is pointing towards the box. The background shows a modern living room with a grey sofa and beige curtains. (5) The older girl holds up the 'Jenga' box to the camera, highlighting the Bowser character and Mario-themed orange blocks. She wears a grey hoodie and stands in front of the same indoor background. (6) The whole family, including a woman in a pink cap and a man in a tan shirt, are gathered around a low table on a grey rug. They are actively playing the board game. Various game pieces, cards, and coins are scattered on the board. (7) Close-up shots of specific game cards are shown: 'Swap', 'Super Leaf', 'Fire Flower', and 'Ice Flower'. Each card is held by a different family member, facing the camera directly to show the text and illustrations. (8) The younger girl and the older girl are lying on the floor, laughing and engaging in a thumb-wrestling match next to the game board. The atmosphere is playful and energetic. (9) The man in the tan shirt and a backwards black cap attempts to pull an orange block from a high Jenga tower. He has a tense, focused facial expression. The tower is tall and slightly unstable. (10) The Jenga tower collapses into a pile of orange blocks on the grey rug. The man looks shocked with his hands up. The three women in the background are seen cheering and raising their hands in celebration.

A sharp 'ding' sound effect punctuates the transition. The music maintains a consistent, driving beat with synthetic bass and percussion. (3) Sound of a plastic mechanical spinner clicking rapidly as it rotates. Speech rate is fast, with family members bantering in Mandarin. The vocal intensity is high, reaching level 4 during cheers. (4) Distinct thudding sounds and plastic clinks occur as game pieces are moved across the board. The BGM swells slightly during a montage sequence. Acoustic texture is bright and clear. (5) A loud, multi-frequency crash sound effect plays as the Jenga tower falls. This is followed by immediate collective cheering and laughter from the three female voices. The spectral brightness is high during this peak event. (6) The video concludes with a calm, narrative-style male voiceover over the continuing upbeat BGM. The voice is professional and warm, with clear articulation. The music fades out slightly at the very end.
